variants.headline: An adverse result is not the whole case
variants.body: Food supply is insufficient in {colony}, leaving people hungry. Practical provision, rather than confidence alone, is the relevant test of any response. We support {target}.

variants.headline: Confidence needs a reasoned assessment
variants.body: People in {colony} are hungry: food supply does not meet their needs. An economic assessment must begin with that essential shortfall. We support {target}.

variants.headline: Support survives the easy verdict
variants.body: Food is insufficient in {colony}, and residents are hungry. A workable answer must connect its proposals to the practical need for adequate supply. We support {target}.
